personal.name: Mujeeb Rahman
personal.role: Computer Lab Assistant | Systems & Network Administration | Web Deployment
personal.bio: Computer lab assistant and student administrator with hands-on experience maintaining workstations, automating lab-wide software deployments, configuring network firewalls, and deploying full-stack web applications.
personal.availabilityStatus: Available for Lab Support, Systems Administration & Web Deployment

paragraphs: I am a student and computer lab assistant based in Kannur, Kerala, managing day-to-day lab operations, terminal maintenance, and multi-system deployment pipelines.

My technical foundation bridges physical infrastructure (pfSense firewalls, Samba Active Directory, FOG Server imaging, custom workstation assembly) with modern web engineering (JavaScript, Next.js, Firebase Auth/Firestore, and automated Vercel workflows).

projects.title: ITQAN Friends Web Portal
projects.description: Production community portal deployed to Vercel featuring Firebase authentication, structured search metadata, and Search Console indexing workflows.
projects.overview: Built and deployed the ITQAN Friends community web portal, optimizing discovery with sitemap architecture, OpenGraph metadata, and Google Search Console indexing.
projects.problem: The organization lacked a centralized digital hub with proper search engine visibility, making resource discovery difficult across mobile and desktop devices.
projects.solution: Engineered an accessible web platform using Next.js and Firebase, structured clean metadata schemas, and established automated Vercel deployments with sitemap generation.
projects.architecture: Next.js App Router for Server-Side Rendering & SEO. Firebase Authentication for user sessions. Firestore for document storage. Google Search Console for real-time indexing.
projects.challenges: Ensuring perfect mobile responsiveness and fast first-contentful paint while maintaining real-time Firestore database queries.
projects.outcome: Live at itqan-friends.vercel.app with verified indexing on Google Search and sub-second page delivery across networks.
projects.lessonsLearned: Gained mastery in configuring automated sitemaps, robots.txt, and metadata tags for optimal production search visibility.

projects.title: Automated Lab Provisioning Suite
projects.description: Modular unattended batch scripts engineered for silent, zero-touch deployment of VS Code, Python, Adobe CC, and Veyon across multiple lab workstations.
projects.overview: Created unattended batch automation scripts to silently install, configure, and verify developer software across computer lab terminals without manual intervention.
projects.problem: Setting up 30+ lab workstations manually after OS installations was slow, repetitive, and prone to configuration discrepancies.
projects.solution: Developed batch scripts with silent installer flags (`/S`, `/qn`, `/silent`), registry configurations, and unattended Veyon client setup over local shares.
projects.architecture: Local network repository holding software packages. Unattended batch scripts executing silently with administrative privileges and error logging.
projects.challenges: Handling differing installer parameters across diverse software packages (Adobe CC vs VS Code vs Veyon) and ensuring clean network-share distribution.
projects.outcome: Reduced full lab provisioning time from multiple hours to a single automated sequence per workstation with zero human error.
projects.lessonsLearned: Learned unattended application packaging, registry injection techniques, and silent service orchestration for educational labs.

projects.title: FOG Server Imaging & NFS Storage
projects.description: Centralized PXE network image distribution platform using FOG Project, LVM partition extension, and dedicated NFS network shared storage.
projects.overview: Configured FOG Server on Linux to deploy disk images across lab computers via PXE boot, with scalable LVM storage partitions and NFS network mounting.
projects.problem: Reinstalling workstations individually from USB flash drives during lab resets was inefficient and caused excessive downtime during academic sessions.
projects.solution: Set up a centralized FOG Server enabling PXE network booting, extended dynamic Linux LVM storage volumes, and connected NFS shares for scalable image storage.
projects.architecture: PXE boot network service, TFTP bootloaders, FOG Server Linux backend, dynamic LVM partition pooling, and NFS shared mounts.
projects.challenges: Dynamic partition resizing using `lvextend` and `resize2fs` while preserving existing disk image repositories without data loss.
projects.outcome: Enabled rapid parallel terminal re-imaging across the entire network in minutes over gigabit ethernet.
projects.lessonsLearned: Mastered Linux storage management (LVM physical volumes, volume groups, logical volumes) and network filesystem exports.

projects.title: Enterprise Firewall, RADIUS & Samba AD
projects.description: Production network topology featuring pfSense firewall, captive portal with RADIUS authentication and billing, and Samba Active Directory domain controller.
projects.overview: Architected and tested secure lab networking policies using pfSense firewalls, captive portal access rules, RADIUS billing authentication, and Samba AD directory services.
projects.problem: Unmanaged lab network traffic without user isolation, bandwidth controls, or central directory authentication created security and administrative overhead.
projects.solution: Deployed pfSense gateway with dedicated captive portal, integrated FreeRADIUS server for credentials/billing, and established Samba AD for domain logons.
projects.architecture: pfSense router/firewall at network perimeter. FreeRADIUS server validating portal sessions. Samba 4 Domain Controller providing Kerberos and LDAP.
projects.challenges: Configuring correct firewall rule hierarchies and RADIUS attribute mappings to properly enforce session duration and bandwidth limits.
projects.outcome: Enforced secure isolated client networks, authenticated user access, and central credential management across lab systems.
projects.lessonsLearned: Deepened understanding of TCP/IP networking, VLAN tagging, firewall state tables, and Active Directory schema administration.

projects.title: Reelagram Media Platform
projects.description: Full-stack media web application featuring user authentication, Firestore real-time database feeds, and responsive media handling.
projects.overview: Built a full-stack media platform implementing Firebase Authentication, Firestore document collections, and modern front-end state management.
projects.problem: Designing an interactive media platform requiring fast user authentication, secure data rules, and real-time feed updates.
projects.solution: Engineered a responsive web client integrated with Firebase Auth for email/password sessions and Firestore security rules to protect user data.
projects.architecture: JavaScript/React front-end with responsive UI. Firebase Authentication for user accounts. Firestore NoSQL database for post feeds and metadata.
projects.challenges: Optimizing real-time listener queries and client-side media rendering to keep mobile performance smooth.
projects.outcome: Achieved seamless authentication flows and instant Firestore sync across connected client sessions.
projects.lessonsLearned: Learned secure Firestore security rules syntax and real-time state synchronization in single-page applications.

projects.title: Itqan Artfeast Web Architecture
projects.description: Managed the GitHub repository, configured continuous Vercel deployment pipelines, and built automated sitemap architecture.
projects.overview: Governed the Itqan Artfeast web repository, automating continuous deployments through Vercel and structuring comprehensive sitemaps for search visibility.
projects.problem: Rapid event updates required zero-downtime automated publishing and search engines needed to index newly released event schedules immediately.
projects.solution: Configured automated GitHub to Vercel deployment pipelines on branch pushes and wrote dynamic sitemap generators for event pages.
projects.architecture: GitHub version control with branch protection. Vercel Edge Network for instant global cache invalidation. Automated XML sitemaps.
projects.challenges: Managing branch merge workflows and ensuring build validation passed before deployment artifacts reached edge servers.
projects.outcome: Delivered continuous deployment with sub-minute build times and automatic sitemap discovery by search crawlers.
projects.lessonsLearned: Mastered Git collaboration workflows, CI/CD edge environments, and search indexing automation.

experience.description: Oversee daily lab operations, workstation hardware maintenance, OS deployment, and network policies across lab terminals. Automate software installations via silent batch scripting, maintain FOG Server imaging, troubleshoot storage/hardware faults, and create organizational print layouts and A3 tabloid publications.
Configured pfSense perimeter firewalls, captive portals with RADIUS billing, Proxmox VE hypervisors, TrueNAS storage pools, NFS mounts, and Samba Active Directory domain controllers.
Engineered, deployed, and maintained full-stack web applications (Itqan Friends, Reelagram, Itqan Artfeast) using Next.js, Firebase Auth/Firestore, Git CI/CD, and Vercel edge infrastructure.

faq.question: What infrastructure and lab systems do you actively manage?
faq.answer: I configure and manage pfSense firewalls, captive portals with RADIUS authentication, Samba Active Directory domain controllers, Proxmox VE hypervisors, FOG Server PXE imaging, NFS shared mounts, and Veyon classroom monitoring across terminal fleets.

faq.question: How do you automate software installation across multiple PCs?
faq.answer: I develop modular Windows batch scripts utilizing silent installer flags (/S, /qn, /silent) for unattended deployment of tools like VS Code, Python, Adobe Creative Cloud, and Veyon from local network shares.

faq.question: What is your web development and deployment stack?
faq.answer: I build applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and Next.js, backed by Firebase Authentication and Firestore NoSQL. Deployments are automated through GitHub repositories connected to Vercel edge networks, complete with sitemap generation and Google Search Console indexing.

faq.question: What design and multimedia work do you produce?
faq.answer: I design A3 tabloid editorial print layouts, organizational event posters, and digital graphics using Adobe Creative Cloud and Canva, alongside video editing and subtitling in Filmora and Premiere.
